description: Shared preview blueprint v1 vectors for the app (TypeScript and PostgreSQL) and the runner (Go). Contract: docs/adr/0050-runner-hosted-preview-controller.md. Regenerate with pnpm previews:blueprint-vectors.
canonical_json: Parse content_json as JSON and validate it. Serialize the parsed value with object keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit order (byte order for these ASCII keys), arrays in order, no whitespace, ECMAScript JSON.stringify string escaping and ECMAScript Number::toString numbers. digest is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of canonical.
